definitions: A South African-born American entrepreneur and business magnate.

The founder, CEO, and chief engineer of SpaceX; angel investor, CEO, and product architect of Tesla, Inc.; owner and CTO of X (formerly Twitter); and founder of The Boring Company, xAI, and co-founder of Neuralink and OpenAI.
examples: Elon Musk is known for his ambitious projects.
Many people follow Elon Musk on social media.
